title: VR MOBILE (Funciona na maioria dos R15)
script: local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService") local Players = game:GetService("Players") local plr = Players.LocalPlayer local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera if shared.SteoryHub_Cleanup then pcall(shared.SteoryHub_Cleanup) end local remote pcall(function() local m = RS:WaitForChild("NexusVRCharacterModel", 8) remote = m:WaitForChild("UpdateInputs", 8) local ready = m:FindFirstChild("ReplicationReady") if ready then ready:FireServer() end end) local CFG = { sendRate = 1 / 30, smooth = 22, reach = 3.5, } local S = { enabled = false, noclip = true, hud = true, } local sin, cos, exp, clamp, abs = math.sin, math.cos, math.exp, math.clamp, math.abs local V3 = Vector3.new local DOWN = V3(0, -1, 0) local conns = {} local function bind(signal, fn) conns[#conns + 1] = signal:Connect(fn) end local function newHand(sign) local rest = V3(sign * 1.0, -0.7, -0.6) return { sign = sign, shoulder = V3(sign * 1.0, 0.6, 0), rest = rest, pos = rest, vel = V3(0, 0, 0), target = rest, roll = 0, rollTarget = 0, cf = CFrame.new(rest), dir = DOWN, } end local hands = {L = newHand(-1), R = newHand(1)} local headSmooth = nil local state = {valid = false, rootCF = CFrame.new(), headCF = CFrame.new(), dirL = DOWN, dirR = DOWN} local function make(class, props, parent) local o = Instance.new(class) for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end o.Parent = parent return o end local function getParent() if gethui then local ok, g = pcall(gethui) if ok and g then return g end end local ok, core = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end) if ok and core then local tested = pcall(function() local t = Instance.new("Folder") t.Parent = core t:Destroy() end) if tested then return core end end return plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end local parentGui = getParent() if parentGui:FindFirstChild("SteoryHub_MobileJoyFixed") then parentGui.SteoryHub_MobileJoyFixed:Destroy() end local gui = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "SteoryHub_MobileJoyFixed", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 99999, IgnoreGuiInset = true, }, parentGui) local panel = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 100), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, Draggable = true, }, gui) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)}, panel) make("UIStroke", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255), Transparency = 0.5, Thickness = 1.2}, panel) local titleLabel = make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "STEORYHUB · VR", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 235, 245), Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 12, }, panel) local vrToggleBtn = make("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 45), Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.42, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40), Text = "Ligar Modo VR", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, BorderSizePixel = 0, }, panel) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)}, vrToggleBtn) local joystickGui = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, }, gui) local function createBlockedJoystick(position, sideLabel) local blocker = make("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 180), Position = position, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, }, joystickGui) local base = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 120), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0, }, blocker) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, base) local label = make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = sideLabel, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13, }, base) local knob = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(55, 55), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, }, base) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, knob) return blocker, knob end local joyLeftBlocker, joyLeftKnob = createBlockedJoystick(UDim2.new(0.18, 0, 0.72, 0), "Mão Esq") local joyRightBlocker, joyRightKnob = createBlockedJoystick(UDim2.new(0.82, 0, 0.72, 0), "Mão Dir") local leftInputId, rightInputId = nil, nil local leftDelta = Vector2.new(0, 0) local rightDelta = Vector2.new(0, 0) local joyRadius = 50 joyLeftBlocker.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if not S.enabled then return end if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not leftInputId then leftInputId = input input:Capture() end end) joyRightBlocker.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if not S.enabled then return end if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not rightInputId then rightInputId = input input:Capture() end end) UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input) if not S.enabled then return end if input == leftInputId then local center = joyLeftBlocker.AbsolutePosition + Vector2.new(90, 90) local current = input.Position local diff = Vector2.new(current.X, current.Y) - center if diff.Magnitude > joyRadius then diff = diff.Unit * joyRadius end joyLeftKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, diff.X, 0.5, diff.Y) leftDelta = diff / joyRadius elseif input == rightInputId then local center = joyRightBlocker.AbsolutePosition + Vector2.new(90, 90) local current = input.Position local diff = Vector2.new(current.X, current.Y) - center if diff.Magnitude > joyRadius then diff = diff.Unit * joyRadius end joyRightKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, diff.X, 0.5, diff.Y) rightDelta = diff / joyRadius end end) local function resetJoysticks() leftInputId, rightInputId = nil, nil leftDelta, rightDelta = Vector2.new(0, 0), Vector2.new(0, 0) joyLeftKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) joyRightKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) end UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) if input == leftInputId then leftInputId = nil leftDelta = Vector2.new(0, 0) joyLeftKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) elseif input == rightInputId then rightInputId = nil rightDelta = Vector2.new(0, 0) joyRightKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) end end) vrToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() S.enabled = not S.enabled if S.enabled then vrToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60) vrToggleBtn.Text = "Desligar VR" joystickGui.Visible = true else vrToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40) vrToggleBtn.Text = "Ligar Modo VR" joystickGui.Visible = false resetJoysticks() state.valid = false end end) local function makeMarker(color, letter) local f = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = 0.55, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, }, gui) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, f) make("UIStroke", {Color = color, Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.1}, f) make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = letter, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, }, f) return f end local markerL = makeMarker(Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), "E") local markerR = makeMarker(Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 255), "D") local function rotBetween(from, to) local dot = clamp(from:Dot(to), -1, 1) local axis = from:Cross(to) if axis.Magnitude < 1e-4 then if dot > 0 then return CFrame.new() end return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.xAxis, math.pi) end return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.acos(dot)) end local joints = {} local function refreshJoints(char) if joints.char == char and joints.neck and joints.neck.Parent then return end joints.char = char joints.neck = char:FindFirstChild("Neck", true) joints.L = char:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder", true) joints.R = char:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder", true) end local function applyJoints() if not S.enabled or not state.valid then return end local char = plr.Character if not char then return end refreshJoints(char) local n, l, r = joints.neck, joints.L, joints.R if n and n.Part0 then n.Transform = n.C0.Rotation:Inverse() * n.Part0.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse() * state.headCF.Rotation * n.C1.Rotation end if l and l.Part0 then local fr = l.Part0.CFrame * l.C0 l.Transform = rotBetween(DOWN, fr:VectorToObjectSpace(state.dirL)) end if r and r.Part0 then local fr = r.Part0.CFrame * r.C0 r.Transform = rotBetween(DOWN, fr:VectorToObjectSpace(state.dirR)) end end local function stepSpring(h, target, dt) local w = CFG.smooth local e = exp(-w * dt) local x = h.pos - target local tmp = h.vel + x * w h.pos = target + (x + tmp * dt) * e h.vel = (h.vel - tmp * w * dt) * e end local function buildHandCF(h) local v = h.pos - h.shoulder local dir = v.Magnitude > 0.05 and v.Unit or DOWN h.dir = dir local up = abs(dir.Y) > 0.98 and V3(0, 0, -1) or Vector3.yAxis h.cf = CFrame.lookAt(h.pos, h.pos + dir, up) end local lastSend = 0 bind(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt) dt = math.min(dt, 0.1) cam = workspace.CurrentCamera local char = plr.Character local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not root or not S.enabled then state.valid = false markerL.Visible = false markerR.Visible = false return end local now = os.clock() local rootCF = root.CFrame local chest = rootCF.Position + rootCF.UpVector * 0.5 + rootCF.LookVector * 1.2 local moveL = V3(leftDelta.X * 1.8, -leftDelta.Y * 1.8, 0) local moveR = V3(rightDelta.X * 1.8, -rightDelta.Y * 1.8, 0) local targetL = rootCF:PointToObjectSpace(chest + cam.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(V3(-0.8, 0, 0) + moveL)) local targetR = rootCF:PointToObjectSpace(chest + cam.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(V3(0.8, 0, 0) + moveR)) hands.L.target = targetL hands.R.target = targetR for _, h in pairs({hands.L, hands.R}) do stepSpring(h, h.target, dt) buildHandCF(h) end local headPos = rootCF.Position + V3(0, 2, 0) local headTarget = CFrame.new(headPos) * cam.CFrame.Rotation if headSmooth then headSmooth = headSmooth:Lerp(headTarget, 1 - exp(-dt * 18)) else headSmooth = headTarget end state.valid = true state.rootCF = rootCF state.headCF = headSmooth state.dirL = rootCF:VectorToWorldSpace(hands.L.dir) state.dirR = rootCF:VectorToWorldSpace(hands.R.dir) applyJoints() if remote and now - lastSend >= CFG.sendRate then lastSend = now remote:FireServer(headSmooth, rootCF * hands.L.cf, rootCF * hands.R.cf) end if S.hud then local pl, onL = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootCF:PointToWorldSpace(hands.L.pos)) local pr, onR = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootCF:PointToWorldSpace(hands.R.pos)) markerL.Visible = onL markerR.Visible = onR markerL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pl.X, pl.Y) markerR.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pr.X, pr.Y) else markerL.Visible = false markerR.Visible = false end end) local ncAcc = 0 bind(RunService.Stepped, function(_, dt) applyJoints() if S.noclip then ncAcc = ncAcc + dt if ncAcc >= 0.1 then ncAcc = 0 for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if other ~= plr and other.Character then for _, p in ipairs(other.Character:GetChildren()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end end end end end end end) shared.SteoryHub_Cleanup = function() for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end S.enabled = false if gui then gui:Destroy() end shared.SteoryHub_Cleanup = nil end
features:
SteoryHub Mobile VR
Sistema de VR para telemóvel com dois joysticks para controlar as mãos (funciona na maioria dos jogos R15). Código aberto, deixe os créditos se for usar em outro script ou publicar, por favor.
